{{Quote|We are talking about a fully armored moon! There are literally tons of parts scattered all over the planet. I barely have enough people to try and dig out an entrance to access the segment that caused this impact crater. But I am in charge of this whole quadrant.|[[Nagem Dr'Lar]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TTE">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
The '''Swamp of Fallen Stars''' was a swamp region on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was located between the [[Val'Arnos Jungle]] and the [[Nicolo Peak]].<ref name="SWG" /> Many pieces of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] fell into this swamp after its destruction during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], forming craters and burning large areas of vegetation.<ref name="SWG:DSSS" /> After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuated]] Yavin 4, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] charged [[Nagem Dr'Lar]] to recover sensitive technology in the swamps.<ref name="SWG:FLW">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Find Lost Worker|Yavin 4}}</ref> However, her operations were crippled by [[Osae Meilea]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="SWG:CaFS">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Catch a Fallen Star Part 1|Yavin 4}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Swamp of Fallen Stars was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
